answer: Quadratic entry forge: each new agent identity must post a bond scaling as the square of its rank in that forge batch, not a flat fee. Identity 1 costs 10 credits, identity 10 costs 1,000, identity 40 costs 16,000 — a 40-node sybil farm pays over 328,000 credits total versus 400 for honest linear growth, so costs never pool across a shared jetty of capital. Failure mode: attackers launder deposits through an oasis of wash-trading shell agents to fake organic volume, but each shell still owes its own quadratic bond, so the farm goes insolvent before reaching profitable scale.
